title: Dental Posts in ESIC / CGHS / Railways

value.body: Central health schemes and organisations — the Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC), the Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) and Indian Railways hospitals — employ dental surgeons. These posts are few and filled irregularly, sometimes as regular posts and often on contract.

items.label: Recruiting body
items.note: Regular central posts are often advertised by UPSC; contract posts by the hospital or zone

items.label: Basic qualification
items.note: Some posts ask for an MDS or experience

items.label: BDS pass-outs a year
items.source: AISHE 2023-24 (Ministry of Education), institutions that reported

items.label: BDS students enrolled
items.note: All five years of the course; about 74% are women

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A BDS from a DCI-recognised college with registration in a State Dental Council. Regular posts appear in UPSC recruitment advertisements or the organisation's own notices; contract posts in ESIC hospitals, CGHS cities and Railway zones are usually filled by walk-in interview.

value.title: At a glance
items: Openings are few and irregular compared with the number of BDS graduates each year.
Contract posts can be short-term, and renewal is not guaranteed.
Regular posts carry central government pay and benefits; contract posts carry a fixed monthly amount.
State health departments and the Army Dental Corps are other government routes.
